summary: RELATE is an open-source courseware package designed to help educators manage educational content. It offers multi-course support, a class calendar, flexible rules, and usage statistics for teaching environments.
goodFor: Instructors and institutions needing a self-hosted platform to organise course schedules, rules, and student statistics under an MIT licence.
watchOut: The project lacks a tagged release history and shows slowing maintenance activity, which may introduce risks for long-term deployments.
deployNotes: As a Python application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination, configure a persistent database, and manage dependencies within a virtual environment.
